segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily skin say the toner controls oiliness and absorbs without feeling greasy, though one notes it can feel too heavy in summer/oilier phases.
segments.dry: Numerous reviewers with dry skin report intense, lasting hydration, softer skin, and relief from tight or flaky dry patches.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as hydrating and non-greasy, though one uses it only at night because it feels like too much moisture during the day.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no irritation, burning, or breakouts, and describe it as calming, gentle, and reducing redness.
segments.normal: One reviewer with otherwise problem-free skin used it mainly to address fine lines and restore moisture and elasticity.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s report the toner keeps skin hydrated, softer, and appearing more youthful with fewer visible fine lines.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and mature skin report improved elasticity, plumper skin, and fewer visible wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe it as deeply hydrating, relieving tightness and dehydrated or dull-feeling skin; one reviewer feels it is not the most hydrating toner on its own and works better layered with other products.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with reactive or flare-prone skin report the toner calms redness quickly and prevents flare-ups.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the toner with repairing or strengthening a damaged skin barrier and reducing sandpaper-like or reactive skin; no negative reports on barrier function appear.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report clearer skin and fewer new blemishes over weeks of use, though effects are described gradually rather than immediately.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or eczema-prone skin report the toner did not cause breakouts and helped keep skin clear; one long-term user with cystic/inflamed acne-prone skin says it helped without clogging pores, though improvement took about two weeks to appear.
concerns.oiliness: Most oily-skin reviewers say it controls oil without stripping or feeling greasy, but one reviewer avoids it in summer when her skin leans oilier because it then feels heavy.

aspects.libelle: Feels heavy in humid or oily conditions

Wish for smaller or travel size

extraits.texte: Ok, so this is a perfect example of not overselling your product, and delivering on your claims. There is nothing fancy or earth shattering about this toner. And it doesn't claim to be. Instead it has simple and straightforward claims of balancing the ph, providing deep hydration, and prepping the skin for your serums without causing irritation. And it does that beautifully! I have dry eczema prone skin while also living in a dry desert climate, and it just drinks this stuff up! I drench my face in it every night, and it's like a powder punch of hydration to the face. And even more surprisingly, you don't need a massive amount. It has a consistency somewhere between a true liquid, and a gel type serum. Like a thick kind of water. It glides onto the skin smoothly, and takes a few moments to sink in. It doesn't just disappear immediately like a true watery toner does. This makes it exceptionally good for dry climates. The moisture isn't just sucked off into the air immediately. It lingers on the skin, allowing the hydration to really penetrate. Because it's so thin, but full of body, you only need a quarter sized amount for your face, neck, and décolletage. And with a bottle that holds more than 6 fl.oz. That's going to last you quite a while. Even if you use it morning and night. If you're oily, or even combo leaning oily, this might be too much for you. extraits.titre: My ride or die for several years
extraits.texte: If you have sensitive reactive skin, however, you do need a deep hydration. This is definitely the product for you. I have been using this product for a couple of years and it's definitely my ride or die toner. My complexion is acne, prone and eczema prone. Therefore, I have a hard time finding products that do not irritate my skin. using this unscented toner, right after I wash my face, it's regulates the pH on my skin. I have noticed skin is less try and reactive, and it also helps enhancing the resilience of my skin. Excellent product. Complimentary from dear Klairs

This has been an instant classic in my skincare routine. I have incredibly inflamed, acne-prone skin that is easily congested yet easy dry. This toner really helped layer on hydration without clogging pores, and maintain a healthy skin barrier. Giant bottle, I drop right in my hands and pat into my face right after cleansing.

extraits.titre: calms my sensitive and reactive skin within minutes!!
extraits.texte: I'm 45 and my skin is changing. It has become sensitive and reactive to certain products; especially, sunscreens. My irritated face gets red and feels extremely spicy. Klair's calmed my face within minutes -I was amazed. I purchased two more during 21 days of beauty.

I received this product complimentary from Dear Klairs in exchange for my honest review. The texture of this toner is medium weight with some viscosity. It's like a serum. I like that it immediatelt hydrates my skin. I wait a couple minutes to let it fully absorb into my skin before I apply the next product in my skincare routine. My skin appears to be more plump afterward. I have oily, combination skin, so I prefer to only use this at night. During the day it may feel a bit too much moisturization. Overall I enjoy it.

I received this product complimentary from dearklairs. This toner has a thicker texture compared to other toners. When my skin feels dull and dehydrated, I like to use this toner to add an extra layer of hydration on my skin. However, I wouldn't use it in the summer when my skin leans towards the oilier side because it can feel heavy on the skin. So far my sensitive skin doesn't react badly to this product and I can see myself using it more regularly in the winter months.

i liked it but it wasn't anything exceptional. it didn't improve nor worsen my skin. i like that it's unscented and not super watery. i won't be repurchasing, but if you have normal/dry skin and aren't acne prone then this would be a good basic toner for you.
